quiz.answer: to put up a good fight

goodToKnow: Wacker means brave, valiant or upright, now old-fashioned and often humorous: sich wacker schlagen (to put up a good fight, typically of an underdog in sport), ein wackerer Kämpfer. It also means heartily: wacker zulangen (to tuck in). Football clubs like Wacker Innsbruck and Wacker Burghausen carry the name. Don't confuse it with wackeln (to wobble).
